text.damagemodifier:
* 0 from champion proc damage abilities
* 1 from minions and monsters
* 1 from champion damage-over-time abilities
* 2 from large minion and monster basic attacks
* 3 from champion area-of-effect abilities
* 4 from ranged champion basic attacks and epic monsters
* 8 from melee champion basic attacks
* 8 from champion single target abilities
* 8 from Smite
* 12 from turrets
text.control:
Zyra's basic attacks apply a refreshing, high-priority mark for 3 seconds against enemy champions, while Thorn Spitters apply a non-refreshing, lesser-priority one for the same duration. Thorn Spitters are static.
# Taunt sources (even if out of range)
# Most recently applied high-priority marks
# Nearest lesser-priority marks to Thorn Spitter
# Non-champions Zyra has most recently attacked
# Closest unit in range
text.targeting: Minion, does not count towards the minion kill tracking score
text.onhit: Thorn Spitters' attacks are mitigated by block and dodge as well as stopped by Blind and Disarm.
text.spelleffects:
Thorn Spitters' basic attacks apply spell effects as area damage.
* A Thorn Spitter deals 50% damage if it is not the first plant to attack its target.
text.abilities:
;Enrage
Thorn Spitters becomes enraged if they are hit by Stranglethorns, resetting their duration, restoring 50% of their current health, increasing their maximum health by 50% and attacking in a flurry for 50% bonus damage.

;Monster Hunter
Thorn Spitters deal 50 – 100 (based on level) bonus damage against non-epic monsters.
